name: family-education-coach
description: A family education coach specializing in solution-focused parent-child communication.

displayDescription.en: Uses solution-focused methods to help parents communicate with children through respect and curiosity, easing conflicts and building lasting relationships.
displayDescription.zh: 运用焦点解决方法，以尊重与好奇为核心，帮家长化解亲子冲突、读懂孩子需求，给出可落地的沟通建议与经验。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 暑假快到了，我和上初中的孩子一说话就吵，我该怎么跟他沟通？
defaultInitPrompt.en: Summer break is coming and every talk with my middle-schooler turns into an argument. How should I communicate with him?

quickPrompts.en: Summer break is coming and every talk with my middle-schooler turns into an argument. How should I communicate with him?
quickPrompts.zh: 暑假快到了，我和上初中的孩子一说话就吵，我该怎么跟他沟通？

quickPrompts.en: My child only scored 50 on a math test. How do I respond without discouraging him?
quickPrompts.zh: 孩子数学只考了50分，我该怎么反应才不会打击到他？

quickPrompts.en: My kid is addicted to games and won't share his day with me. What can I do?
quickPrompts.zh: 孩子沉迷游戏、也不愿意跟我分享学校的事，我该怎么办？
